I really just like one song from this album, but i decided to remaster it anyway because the underlying mix is strong, it's just that it's too smashed up. I used Izotope RX11 as a declipper, EQd it, low passed it, used Dynamic Mirror, applied a soft clipper, and then softly limited it. I didn't want to do one of those *audiophile* fan releases where it's just mostly high passed just so the DR meter shows a high DR.
